title: Renew a subscription
summary: The Renew… dialog over the past-due license: the new period end defaulting to one period after the current one, an optional note for the history, the one result (Past due → Active), and one link to the admin API that does the same from DJDL's own billing.
compare: Opens over the past-due license (entitlements.license-subscription) from the health line's Renew… (or the Subscription card's ⋯), with focus in New period end, prefilled one period (a year) after the current period end. Any date after today is allowed, and the hint says so; a date on or before today shows 'Pick a date after today, Oct 7, 2026.' inline under the field, and Renew moves focus there instead of saving.
The note is optional, opens empty with the placeholder 'Invoice number, how it was paid', and shows in the subscription's history and Activity.

The summary states the one result before saving: 'Status: Past due → Active'. The one-day margin (a renewal recorded on the day doesn't cut the license off) shows on the license's own Runs until value, not here, so the dialog has one date: the one on its button.

One link line names the admin API for DJDL's own billing: 'Renew from DJDL’s billing with the admin API →' (to its docs, rule 10). The console never shows Renew… for App Store, Google Play or Polaris Key checkout subscriptions.
The primary button repeats the date: 'Renew to Oct 7, 2027'. After saving, a toast says 'Renewed to Oct 7, 2027' and the health line disappears.

Phone: a bottom sheet whose body scrolls under a fade above the foot when it needs to (.dialog.scroll.fade, the body a focusable region); Cancel and Renew to Oct 7, 2027 sit side by side in two equal columns, in tab order.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fix, then pass: the second date is explained where it appears, the note opens empty, and the API route is one line with Copy and docs.

findings.issue: The summary says 'License runs until Oct 8, 2027' while the field and button say Oct 7, with no reason; the hint uses 'term', which the glossary keeps for legal terms.
findings.resolution: Under the summary: 'A day after the period ends, so a renewal recorded on the day doesn’t cut it off.' The hint now reads 'Change it to renew for a different length. It has to be after today.'

findings.issue: The optional Note opens with dark prefilled text; the API route wraps mid-id with no Copy; the error for a date before today isn't drawn.
findings.resolution: Note opens empty with a muted placeholder ('Invoice number, how it was paid'). The route is a one-line code block with no shell prompt, a Copy button and an 'Admin API docs' link: it shows 'POST …/subscriptions/sub_4K1…/renew', and Copy takes the full /manage/api/products/djdl/… route. Declined to draw the date error in this state: the dialog always opens with a valid date (one period after the current end), so the error can't appear next to the default. The compare gives its exact text and place, and the hint now states the rule. The page behind takes the license record's fixes.

findings.issue: The API path (a sentence, a link line and a code block) took about 100px of an operator's dialog; two dates a day apart (Oct 7 on the button, Oct 8 in the summary) made the main fact doubtful.
findings.resolution: One link line, 'Renew from DJDL’s billing with the admin API →'; the summary shows only 'Status: Past due → Active' (the margin lives on the license's Runs until value); .dialog.scroll.fade for the phone sheet. The page behind is the converged license-subscription. The screen opts into the lead's new kit defaults with .kit-next on its console root (in-sentence links underlined, the warm light warning tint, 44px phone targets, the one-row phone save bar, two-up sheet feet, the white light-theme switch knob, the segmented ring, aligned On/Off, status words at the cell size).

findings.issue: Builders would copy ARIA that axe flags: switches named 'On', presets and filters as role=tablist with no tabs, an unnamed breadcrumb nav, glyph-only kind icons.
findings.resolution: Switches are <button class="switch" role="switch" aria-checked aria-labelledby="<row title>">; presets, the Versions and When it ends groups, the kind and ledger filters and the holder control are role=radiogroup with role=radio items; crumbs are <nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">; a glyph that stands alone (a kind icon on phone, a feature glyph) is role=img with an aria-label, and decorative glyphs and avatar initials are aria-hidden. axe-core 4.13 reports 0 violations on all 12 screens, both themes, at 1440 and 390.

findings.issue: Move the stored version range, and renew's one-day margin, into tooltips.
findings.resolution: declined: ADMIN.md P6 puts no facts in hover-only places, and tooltips are invisible on touch. Instead the stored range appears after 'Set a range instead', and the margin lives on the license's Runs until value.

findings.issue: Update the compares to say the phone dialog feet and the add-on header actions stack full width.
findings.resolution: declined: The kit now puts two actions side by side (.kit-next sheet feet, .action-pair). That fixes the reversed visual vs tab order and matches the existing compares, so the render changes and the compares don't.

findings.issue: Lines restated the title or narrated mechanism.
findings.resolution: 'Records a paid renewal.' and 'Shown in History and Activity.' deleted; date helper 'A year after Oct 7, 2026' with 'Must be after today' as the error; note placeholder 'Invoice number or how it was paid'; the button reads 'Renew to Oct 7, 2027'; the admin API link is a tertiary link at the footer's left, shortened to 'Renew with the admin API'; the invalid-date state is drawn beside the default (desktop and tablet; phone shows the default sheet).

findings.issue: Dialog geometry and summary rows as for extend-major.
findings.resolution: Same viewport-tall screen, 12vh placement, scrolling body, pinned foot and shared summary row.
